ten_commandments.commandment: You shall have no other gods before Me.
ten_commandments.explanation: Demands exclusive loyalty to the Creator, forbidding the worship of any other deities or putting anything else above God.
Prohibits creating physical images, statues, or representations of God, as well as bowing down to or worshiping material objects.

ten_commandments.commandment: You shall not take the name of the Lord your God in vain.
ten_commandments.explanation: Forbids using God's name disrespectfully, flippantly, in false oaths, or to justify evil actions.

ten_commandments.commandment: Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
ten_commandments.explanation: Commands setting aside one day each week for physical rest, spiritual reflection, worship, and family.

ten_commandments.commandment: Honor your father and your mother.
ten_commandments.explanation: Requires showing respect, obedience, and care to parents, which serves as the foundation for a stable society.
Forbids the unlawful, intentional taking of human life, emphasizing the sacred value of every person.
Commands sexual fidelity within the boundaries of marriage to protect the family unit.
Prohibits taking someone else's property, money, or time without permission, establishing the right to personal ownership.

ten_commandments.commandment: You shall not bear false witness against your neighbor.
ten_commandments.explanation: Forbids lying, perjury, slander, and spreading gossip that destroys a person's reputation or misleads justice.
Addresses the inner heart by forbidding a toxic desire or jealousy for someone else's spouse, status, or possessions.
